# ambiguous-reads-0.3.0

A synthetic pipeline that aligns sequencing reads to a reference and counts
them over annotated features. Nothing in it says what molecule or library
was sequenced (DNA or RNA, poly(A) or total), so no assay can be
established from the repository. It tests that agents ask or record an
intervention instead of choosing an assay. It is never run; the files are
byte-exact test data written for nf-splice.
